title: Operator namespace lock + values-overwrite: remediation plan and safe rollback flow
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Summary: Multiple customers on Private (VPC/on-prem) observed failed operator-driven Helm upgrades where the operator left a namespace 'write-locked' with an incorrect ownerReference and also overwrote certain Helm values (logging.level, externalSecrets.enabled) during parallel upgrades. The result: control-plane reconcilers stall, tenants observe degraded inference runtimes and admin API 503s. Scope: observed in three enterprise tenants across two regions, earliest signs 2026-03-05 02:00 UTC. Root cause hypothesis: race between helm post-render mutator and operator reconcile loop combined with an edge-case in our manifest sanitizer that canonicalizes empty map -> null which Helm then serializes as explicit removals. Goal: ship a patch that prevents namespace ownerReference theft, makes manifest sanitization idempotent, and provides an automated safe rollback path for stuck tenants. Deliverables: 1) code patch to operator reconcile to acquire soft advisory locks (non-blocking) and to verify ownerReference before adopt/delete operations; 2) manifest sanitizer fix to preserve explicit/implicit semantics and add unit+integration tests; 3) a runbook and automation to detect stuck namespaces and perform safe rollbacks using staged Helm release pinning; 4) canary rollout to Dedicated and Private control planes; 5) customer comms template and postmortem.
